spans.s: शिबि(वि) m. 1. A beast of prey; 2. the birch tree; 3. name of a king.
शिबि(वि)का f. 1. A palanquin, a litter; 2. a bier.
शिबि(वि)र n. 1. A camp, an encampment, संध्यांशुभिन्नघनकर्बुरितांतरीक्षलक्ष्मीविडंबि शिबिरं शिवकीर्तनस्य Sis.v.68; 2. an intrenchment for the protection of an army; 3. a kind of grain.
शिबी(वी)रथ m. A palanquin, a litter.
